participant_id.Description: The participant identifier indicates the participant that was scanned.

session_id.Description: The session identifier indicates the longitudinal session at which the participant was scanned.

Levels.ses-1: The first neuroimaging session; all participants went through at least one neuroimaging session
Levels.ses-2: The second neuroimaging session (not all participants have a second session)
Levels.ses-3: The third neuroimaging session (not all participants have a third session)

run.Description: Run number; note that resting state scans were meant to have 2 runs, and nback scans were meant to have 1 run, but there are cases of an unexpected third run for resting-state scans if the MRI tech decided to re-do a run.

median_FD.Description: A measure of overall head movement, created by adding the frame-to-frame differences in head motion parameters and taking the median over all time points

low_coverage_sum.LongName: The sum of all regions (from Schaefer 1000 atlas with additional subcortical regions) with coverage less than 50% for that scan.
low_coverage_sum.Description: This counts the total number of regions for that scan that had coverage of less than 50%

qc_determination.Description: The final categorical determination of the scan's quality.

Levels.Fail: The scan fails QC. A scan fails if it has a median FD > 0.3 and/or more than 3 regions with incomplete coverage.
Levels.Pass: The scan passes QC and should be included in analyses.
